name: @githq/worker
description: The githq Cloudflare Worker: serves the static SPA and the docs from its assets and runs only for /, /api/*, /download/* and /docs/*

scripts.dev: mkdir -p ../app/.output/public && touch ../../.env && GITHQ_ENV=dev sh ../../scripts/withSecrets.sh wrangler dev --port 8788 --env-file ../../.env
scripts.secrets:put:prod: env -u GITHUB_CLIENT_SECRET GITHQ_ENV=prod bun nzyme secrets run -- sh -c 'printf %s "$GITHUB_CLIENT_SECRET" | wrangler secret put GITHUB_CLIENT_SECRET'
